title: Senior Marketing Manager, Channel Sales
description:

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions - to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes - large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

Not every seller comes to Square directly. A growing number reach us through resellers who sell Square on our behalf, and through independent contractors who represent Square in their own communities. Together these two motions make up our channel sales function.

title: Full Time Senior Full-Stack Developer
description:
Overview

We are hiring a Senior Full-stack Developer. You will build and ship new products across a portfolio of companies. You work from the backlog alongside your team, and you manage your own day-to-day work. You also help our digital marketing agency with technical needs from time to time. The work happens in TypeScript and JavaScript stacks, with AWS and mobile app releases as part of the work.

About Us

New products here start on Lovable and similar platforms so we can test them fast. The ones that work get taken over with time, which means moving the code, the infrastructure, and the app store accounts into our own hands. As our first hire, you are how that handoff begins, and you set the technical foundation the rest of the team builds on.

What You Will Do

•
Build and Ship Production Code. You write and own full-stack code in React, TypeScript, and Node.js, and you take products from AI-generated prototypes into production.

•
Make Sure Stakeholders Never Find a Bug. You test your work before it reaches a stakeholder. That means writing automated tests, testing on web and on real iOS and Android devices, and releasing only when it holds up.

•
Rapid AI Prototyping and Development. You use our AI-assisted workflows (Lovable, Cursor, and emerging AI agents) to spin up and validate feature prototypes quickly. Then you carry them into full engineering production, including the call on when a product has outgrown its starter platform and needs to move to our own codebase and AWS setup.

•
Hands-on Architecture and Code Review. You review code, diagnose build bottlenecks, and directly program code overrides or refinements when AI generation tools hit their limits. You set the technical standards so the output stays clean, type-safe, and scalable.

•
Work From Specs and Sharpen Them. You build from the specs and acceptance criteria written by our product manager and stakeholders. When you spot a gap, you raise it early and propose a solution.

•
Ship Mobile Releases. You manage App Store and Google Play submissions, review responses, and release schedules for our mobile apps.

•
Support the Agency. You help with the agency's technical needs as they come up, including AWS accounts, hosting, access, software costs, and the technical side of client projects.

Tech Stack

• React, TypeScript, and Node.js, front end and back end

• Supabase and PostgreSQL for application back ends and databases

• AWS for hosting and infrastructure

• Data warehouse storage for reporting and analytics

• AI-assisted development with Lovable, Cursor, Windsurf, v0, and emerging AI agents, where most new products begin

• WordPress for marketing sites, hosted on Cloudways

• iOS and Android app releases through the App Store and Google Play

Requirements

•
Deep Coding Expertise: 7+ years of hands-on full-stack development experience (React, TypeScript, Node.js, and Supabase/PostgreSQL). You have the technical authority to audit other developers' work and enforce structural code quality.

•
Self-Directed Work: You manage your own time and priorities, take direction once, and carry it through without needing a manager to check on you.

•
AI-Augmented Workflow Competency: Active, practical experience using AI code creation or agentic tools (Lovable, Cursor, Windsurf, v0, or similar platforms) to speed up application prototyping and delivery workflows.

•
Product Mindset: Strong UI/UX awareness, product intuition, and the ability to think like a tech founder. You spot product gaps and propose solutions proactively, without needing detailed design direction.

Licensed Professional Counselor (LPC) $62 K-80K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth , we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

• 401K with maximum employee matching.

• Health care benefits.

• Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.

• Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.

• Full administrative support.

• Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.

• Customized schedules within available clinic hours.

• Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).

• Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.

• Incredible administrative support team.

• Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.

title: Ocean Import Specialist
description:
About Expedock

We are a tech-enabled workforce augmentation platform leveraging top 1% offshore talent & cutting edge technology to enable businesses to unlock their full potential
About the Client
Our client is a US-based logistics provider recognized for delivering reliable, efficient, and customer-focused supply chain solutions. With years of experience in domestic and international freight, they support shippers through smart processes, responsive communication, and modern operational tools. Their services cover a wide range of logistics needs, ensuring that every shipment is handled with accuracy, transparency, and care.
Schedule:Night Shift
Location:Fully Remote (WFH)
The Mission: Manage end-to-end ocean import shipments, ensuring compliance with global trade regulations while proactively identifying, managing, and resolving exceptions through close coordination with overseas agents, carriers, customs brokers, and internal teams.
What You'll Do:

• Pre-Arrival Coordination & Arrival Notice Management

• Receive pre-alert/shipment documents from origin offices or overseas agents.

• Follow up with steamship lines for ISF confirmation, Arrival Notice, and freight invoices.

• Review all charges (ocean freight, origin costs, documentation fees, amendments, etc.) and prepare accurate Arrival Notice billing.

• Issue Arrival Notice + invoice to the consignee/brokerminimum 7 days prior to vessel arrival(or immediately for late vessels) to ensure timely payment and avoid delays.

• Customs Clearance & Last Free Day (LFD) Management

• Coordinate with customs broker for clearance status and resolve any holds (exam, AMS, PGA, etc.).

• Track Last Free Day for both demurrage (storage) and detention (container use) daily.

• Proactively send LFD alerts and reminders to consignee/broker starting 7 days before LFD, then 3 days, 2 days, and daily countdown once inside 48 hours.

• Escalate to management when consignee is unresponsive or LFD is at risk.

• Delivery Coordination & Trucking Arrangement

• Arrange delivery with truckers once cargo is cleared and available (or on wheels if live unload).

• Coordinate with consignee/broker on delivery appointments, special requirements (liftgate, inside delivery, etc.).

• Handle any delivery exceptions (refused cargo, storage orders, redelivery fees) and ensure additional costs are approved and billed to consignee.

• Container Return Monitoring & Detention/Per Diem Management

• Monitor empty container return status daily after delivery.

• Follow up with consignee/trucker for proof of empty return before detention clock expires.

• Calculate and bill any detention/per diem charges incurred due to late return; ensure payment is collected from consignee (never absorbed by us unless pre-approved).

• Dispute incorrect carrier detention invoices when applicable.

• File Closure, Cost Reconciliation & Customer Communication

• Reconcile final carrier and vendor invoices against quoted/billed amounts.

• Issue any debit notes for additional charges (detention, demurrage, exam fees, waiting time, etc.) and follow up for payment.

• Obtain proof of delivery, close file in system, upload all final documents, and release final invoice to customer.

• Act as single point of contact for consignee throughout the shipment: provide proactive status updates, answer queries, resolve issues, and ensure complete customer satisfaction.

What You Need:

• 2-4 years experienceinOcean Import Operations(FCL & LCL required)

• Strong understanding ofUS import proceduresincluding ISF, AMS, PGA holds, customs clearance, demurrage, and detention

• Hands-on coordination experience withsteamship lines, customs brokers, truckers, and overseas agents

• Ability to track and manageLast Free Day (LFD)for both demurrage and detention

• Experience handlingdelivery appointments, trucking arrangements, delivery exceptions, and cost approvals

• Proficiency infreight forwarding systems/TMS

• Amenable to working the night

title: Senior Systems and Certification Engineer
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Sr. Systems and Certification Engineer to join our team at Collinear Group . As a Sr. Systems and Certification Engineer, you will play a crucial role in supporting our clients and ensuring the certification of aerospace systems in highly regulated environments. Your expertise and experience certifying complex systems with design practices considering system level performance and aerospace certification requirements - such as ARP4754, DO-178, DO-254, DO-160, 14CFR 23/25/29/33/35 and MIL-STDs - will support our mission to make complex aerospace and defense product lifecycles elegantly simple, bending the industry cost curve.
Responsibilities include:

• Developing systems and component level requirements for design and verification within the Systems Engineering and Certification operating group and projects.

• Working closely with cross-functional teams to develop qualification plans and artifacts required for compliance to satisfy regulatory agencies.

Requirements
What you'll need:

• Bachelor’s degree in aerospace engineering, mechanical engineering or related field and/or equivalent education and experience

• 5+ years experience in large scale systems design and certification environments

• Advanced experience in design practices with consideration for system level performance and aerospace certification requirements including SAE ARP4754, RTCA/DO-178, RTCA/DO-254, RTCA/DO-160, 14CFR 23/25/29/33/35 and MIL-STDs

• Demonstrated experience with FAA conformity and airworthiness processes, including:

• FAA Form 8130-3 (Authorized Release Certificate / Airworthiness Approval Tag) documenting approval for return to service or airworthiness of aircraft articles

• FAA Form 8130-9 (Statement of Conformity) certifying that articles or test articles conform to the approved design data for certification testing

• FAA Form 8100-1 (Conformity Inspection Record) documenting FAA conformity inspections for certification programs

• Experience supporting FAA certification activities, including coordination with FAA designees (DERs, ODA, or FAA representatives) and participation in conformity inspections and certification audits.

• Excellent communication skills with the ability to facilitate teamwork across functions

Nice to have:

• Experience with requirements and program management tools

• Experience in a FAA-regulated environment

• Some ability to work onsite in our Puget Sound service area or occasional travel to customer sites nationwide

• Experience with full Type Certification programs

• eVTOL or AAM program experience

Benefits

Why Collinear?
Join a highly-talented community of like-minded peers practiced at accomplishing big goals. Work on high-impact projects to transform aerospace while developing new skills, insights, connections, and experience.
For this position, Collinear offers a salary range of $140,000 to $165,000 (DOE) with bonus and profit sharing programs, health insurance, HSA contributions, a 401(k) program with company contributions, nine paid holidays, 15 days of PTO accrued per year, non-prescribed amount of sick leave, flexible schedules and remote working capabilities, and multiple company-sponsored employee events - all in support of creating an employee-focused company.

With millions of diners, 70,000+ restaurant partners and 25+ years of experience, OpenTable , part of Booking Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: BKNG), is an industry leader with a passion for helping restaurants thrive. Our world-class technology empowers restaurants to focus on what matters most - their team, their guests, and their bottom line - while enabling diners to discover and book the perfect restaurant for every occasion.
Every employee at OpenTable has a tangible impact on what we do and how we do it. You’ll also be part of a global team and its portfolio of metasearch brands. Hospitality is all about taking care of others, and it defines our culture.
About the Job
As a Remote Enterprise Account Manager, you will manage a premium portfolio of restaurant groups and strategic accounts, taking full ownership of client relationships to maintain high retention rates and foster satisfaction. Your goal is to drive deep utilization of our services by building meaningful, high-level connections with decision-makers and conducting insightful business reviews. This impact-focused role involves delivering tailored training to maximize the value of software and marketing tools while gathering critical feedback to influence product enhancements. You will act as a trusted advisor, playing a key role in shaping account management strategies, driving revenue growth, and helping restaurants optimize their operations with data-driven insights.
Note: Applicants must reside in the United States. Dallas or Houston residence strongly preferred.
Responsibilities

• Manage a premium portfolio of restaurant groups and strategic accounts, driving client retention, revenue growth, and deep utilization of services.

• Serve as a trusted advisor to decision-makers, conducting business reviews and delivering tailored training on software and marketing tools.

• Educate clients on industry trends and leverage data-driven insights to help them optimize their restaurant operations.

• Act as the primary liaison between clients and internal departments, ensuring exceptional support and resolving critical issues efficiently.

• Partner with Product and Marketing teams by sharing market feedback to influence future developments and enhancements.

• Travel 30-50% to build and maintain face-to-face relationships with clients and deliver in-person presentations.

Minimum Qualifications

• 5+ years of experience in account management or restaurant management.

• Proven expertise in consultative account management and a strong understanding of restaurant operations.

• Strong aptitude for data-driven decision-making and providing actionable business insights.

• Exceptional organizational, time management, and cross-departmental collaboration skills.

• Ability to travel 30-50% depending on location to engage with clients. Applicants must reside in the United States.

Preferred Qualifications

• Food and Beverage Management experience within a hospitality group.

• Experience utilizing CRM solutions such as Salesforce.

• Familiarity with reservation software or restaurant table management software.

• Demonstrated ability to thrive in unstructured, entrepreneurial environments.

• Dallas or Houston residence strongly preferred.

Benefits and Perks

• Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year

• Focus on mental health and well-being:

• Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth

• Company-paid subscription to Headspace

• Annual company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)

• Paid parental leave

• Generous paid vacation + time off for your birthday

• Paid volunteer time

• Focus on your career growth:

• Development Dollars

• Leadership development

• Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings

• Travel Discounts

• Employee Resource Groups

• Competitive retirement and health plans

Note for MA applicants: It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test

Capable of working effectively under supervision while also demonstrating initiative and accountability in completing tasks independently. Maintains a strong work ethic, reliability, and commitment to excellence in all responsibilities, with a focus on integrity, confidentiality, and continuous improvement. description:

At HelloConnect, you will be part of a dynamic team that embraces innovation and leverages advanced technology to create exceptional experiences. Our culture is built on collaboration, continuous learning, and a commitment to excellence. You’ll have the opportunity to work on impactful projects, develop your skills, and grow within a supportive environment that values diverse perspectives and experiences.

In this role, you will take on a key responsibility in serving as the primary point of support for operational questions raised through the Learning Channel while investigating and resolving complex customer inquiries, contributing to our ongoing efforts to drive business success and enhance customer satisfaction.

We’re looking for passionate individuals who can bring their unique skills and ideas to the table. Even if you don't meet every requirement but believe you’d excel in this role, we’d love to hear from you!

 

What you’ll do

The SME role will initially focus on two key operational responsibilities, aligned with the campaign’s immediate needs.

Learning Channel Support: Serve as the primary point of support for operational questions raised through the Learning Channel by frontline agents, including those in training and nesting.

• Coordinate with Team Leaders to prioritize queue support while maintaining coverage for Learning Channel and Handover Inbox responsibilities.

• Problem-Solving & Judgement: Ability to investigate customer issues, identify solutions, and make sound decisions within approved authority limits.

• Communication & Knowledge Sharing: Clear and effective communication, with the ability to guide and support fellow agents.

title: Research Communications Lead, Physical AI
description:
About us

We're solving AI's hardest problem: alignment.

Encord is the data layer for Physical AI and enterprise, serving as core infrastructure for 300+ of the world's leading AI teams, including Woven by Toyota, Hitachi, Skydio, AbbVie and Dyna, Walden and Agility Robotics. From autonomous vehicles and robotics to sports and healthcare, we're solving AI's hardest problem: turning complex, real-world data into production-ready intelligent systems.

We're a team of founders, scientists, quants, researchers, and former Olympians, who’ve helped build some of the most successful companies in Silicon Valley, and alumni of MIT, Stanford, UC Berkeley, Oxford, Cambridge, and Imperial. We’ve raised $110M from legendary technology investors, early backers of companies like Databricks, ElevenLabs and Vercel, and we’re growing at an extraordinary pace.

We're looking for exceptional people who want to help build a category-defining company, operating with high urgency and taking real ownership to help shape the future of AI.

The role

We recently released Encord Data Labs https://encord.com/data-labs/: our research arm through which we'll be sharing some of the lessons learned from our internal research on how data actually moves model performance in the physical world.

We're looking for our first Research Communications Lead, to build and drive our Data Labs research and publishing motion. You won't just be on the author list, you'll be identifying interesting problems and topics to explore, and working with the rest of our ML team to shape their results into research that helps progress our field.

This is a front-row seat to some of the most important technical challenges in physical AI, with a direct line to our research team and co-founders, as well as chance to explore the end-to-end journey of building autonomous systems and getting them to work in the real world.

A taste of what Data Labs has worked on and published in its first months:

- EMG-1 https://encord.com/data-labs/introducing-emg-1/: we released the largest open dataset of wrist EMG synced with egocentric video: 307 hours of real work captured on head and wrist cameras, plus a 10.4-hour lab set with optical mocap, over 30x larger than the next public dataset of its kind

- EMG + vision fusion https://encord.com/data-labs/introducing-emg-1/: by adding muscle signals to camera-based hand tracking, we were able to reduce median fingertip error by ~25%, and ~35% when hands were briefly occluded

- Encord-REACH https://encord.com/data-labs/hands-at-work-egocentric-hand-pose-tracking/: we built a video-native 3D hand pose model for egocentric work scenes, now in production with robotics teams; it cuts wrist tracking error by 80% and joint error by 65%, is 30-70% more accurate on industrial gloves, and almost never swaps in a bystander's hand

- Synthetic data for ANYbotics https://encord.com/data-labs/nvidia-anybotics-synthetic-data/: using NVIDIA Cosmos Data Factory to turn 410 reference images of industrial sites into 1,500+ short clips, we lifted ANYbotics' inspection anomaly recall by 24%, for ~$55 of generation

What you'll do

- Own the Data Labs research ideation: identify interesting and important topics worth dedicating resources to, collaborate with the broader ML team on the research process, and articulate our findings in a clear and compelling way

- Partner with customers' research teams on joint research and case studies relating to their data pipelines

- Work hand in hand with our broader ML team to scope, structure and draft research on topics ranging from embodied data collection approaches, to data curation, VLAs and world models

- Build Data Labs publishing machine: a calendar, a review process with research, and templates for posts, benchmark launches, dataset releases and paper companions

- Distribute every piece where the broader field can find it: X, LinkedIn, Hugging Face, arXiv companions, newsletters, podcasts and conferences such as CoRL, IR

title: Product Marketing Manager
description:
About Axonius

Axonius is the asset intelligence platform. We give Security and IT teams a complete, trusted view of every asset across their environment: the foundation they need to adopt AI-first cybersecurity with confidence. As AI changes how security gets done, we’re building on that foundation to deliver AI-first exposure management and to help customers secure their AI assets.
About our team
You’ll join a team of experienced cybersecurity marketers who have worked at companies of every size and stage. Some of us have taken companies out of stealth, and others have joined at a growth stage and seen them through to IPO. You’ll learn from people with deep cyber and marketing experience, and you’ll own your product area from day one.
About the role
As Axonius enters an AI-first era, the story we tell must keep pace. As our Product Marketing Manager, you’ll shape how we talk about the product and the role of AI in cybersecurity. You’ll also help ensure our field teams across sales, sales engineering, and customer success can tell that story with confidence. This is a hands-on role. You’ll write the words, build the assets, and spend time with the people who use them: our field, customers, and partners.
What you’ll do

•
Positioning and messaging : Craft new positioning and messaging as we enter an AI-first era. Turn product capabilities into clear value propositions across web copy, product collateral, and narratives that resonate with our buyers.

•
Product partnership : Work closely with Product to understand what’s being built and why. Turn the roadmap and launches into clear messaging, and bring customer and field feedback to the product team.

•
Sales enablement : Help sales understand both the Axonius product and the role of AI in cybersecurity. Build the collateral, talk tracks, and training that sellers use.

•
Demand generation support: Partner with demand gen and regional marketing on campaigns, ensuring messaging and content land with the right audiences in each segment.

•
Product differentiation : Raise awareness of what sets Axonius apart, in the market and inside deals.

•
Customer conversations : Talk directly with customers, including roadmap discussions, and bring what you learn back into product positioning.

What you’ll bring

• 3+ years of product marketing experience, preferably in cybersecurity. B2B experience in adjacent fields is also welcome.

• Strong writing and communication skills, with experience crafting product descriptions, web copy, sales collateral, and demos.

• Comfort enabling field teams across the organization, including sales, sales engineering, and customer success.

• Confidence leading customer conversations, including roadmap discussions.

Education

• Bachelor’s degree in technology, computer science, marketing, or communications preferred.
What success looks like
In your first 90 days

• You understand the Axonius platform, our buyers, and where AI fits in our story.

• You’ve listened to sales calls and spoken with customers, and you know the questions that come up most.

• You’ve shipped your first piece of messaging or collateral, and sellers are using it.

In your first year

• New AI-first messaging is live across the website, sales collateral, and campaigns, and it reads as one consistent story.

• Sellers choose your material over building their own.

• Regional and demand gen campaigns related to your area of ownership launch with clear, differentiated messaging.

• Our differentiators come up more often in deals and in how prospects describe us.

• Product hears customer and field feedback from you, and it shapes positioning and roadmap conversations.

Head of Brazil

São Paulo, Brazil | Reports to the CEO | Travel to San Francisco once or twice a month

 

About Terac

Terac is an AI-native expert marketplace. We connect a large global network of verified contributors to paid work for market research firms and AI and human data labs. The company is growing fast, and we've raised $16M from Emergence Capital, SV Angel, SignalFire and others.

 

One of our fastest-growing lines is physical workforce: real-world data collection sold directly to frontier robotics labs. We already run active operations in Brazil.

 

The role

As Head of Brazil, you will open Terac's São Paulo office and build the local team that scales physical workforce operations across Latin America. You report directly to Zac, our Co-Founder and CEO, who will be on the ground in São Paulo to help get the office open.

 

The role covers operations, business development, and team-building. You will be a core part of the company and very involved in how this business line takes shape.

 

What you'll do

- Open and run the São Paulo office and hub.

- Own day-to-day field operations for real-world data collection: onboarding partner businesses, managing devices and daily data logistics, and hitting delivery and quality targets.

- Sign and grow local partner businesses, and support our relationships with frontier robotics lab customers.

- Hire and lead a local team.

- Build the forecasting, quotas, and reporting that turn the ramp into a science.

- Expand into new environments and new countries across Latin America.

 

Who you are

- You have a founder mentality and want to start your own company one day.

- You have early-stage startup experience in Brazil or the US, or you currently run your own small business and want a new challenge.

- You are comfortable owning messy, physical operations from end to end.

- You are fluent in Portuguese and English.

 

Backgrounds that tend to fit well include Chief of Staff, Head of Operations, strategy consulting, and other operator roles.

 

What we offer

- Salary: $100K to $150K.

- Commission: $100K to $200K a year, as a direct revenue share on the business you bring in.

- Benefits: health insurance.

We’re looking for a hands-on technical leader to build the incident response team that protects OpenAI as AI capabilities and the threats surrounding them evolve. You will command consequential incidents, lead technically demanding investigations, and make containment and recovery decisions when evidence is incomplete and the stakes are high. You will also shape how frontier models change incident response: using OpenAI’s own technology to help responders connect evidence, test hypotheses, and act effectively at a scale that manual workflows cannot support. - Drive incidents to verified closure. Work with accountable owners to validate containment and recovery, document remaining risk, and track corrective actions that reduce the likelihood or impact of recurrence.

- Coordinate with engineering, infrastructure, legal, privacy, and other stakeholders throughout an incident. Give executives clear updates on impact, uncertainty, decisions, and the next update without overstating what the evidence supports.

- Build sustainable on-call coverage, escalation paths, and handoffs across regions. Balance urgent response with training and planned improvements, and protect the team’s ability to recover after demanding incidents.

- Build readiness into new research and infrastructure capabilities with their owners. Exercise playbooks, escalation paths, and containment options, including scenarios involving agents operating across systems at scale.

title: Logistics Lead

You will own our 3PL relationship with Radial for DTC and Retail fulfillment, manage orders from creation to delivery, and keep shipping fast, accurate, and cost-effective through our spring peak. Order Management & Shipping

• Evaluate carriers and ship methods for cost and reliability, and recommend changes

• Define functional requirements for order and shipping systems with Tech, and maintain data integrity across our ERP, Radial, and order systems

Cost, Reporting & Process

• Own logistics budget line items day to day, and find cost savings and avoidance in warehousing and outbound shipping

Qualifications
Experience

• 4+ years of experience in logistics, fulfillment, or customer operations, including hands-on 3PL management

• Experience running DTC e-commerce fulfi

title: SOC Analyst (16:00–01:00 UTC)
description:
About the job
The SOC Analyst is responsible for the continuous monitoring, triage, and investigation of security events across the organization's environment, as part of a global follow-the-sun Security Operations Center. This position reports to the SOC Lead. The role goes beyond acknowledging alerts: the focus is on understanding what each alert means, investigating suspicious activity end to end, responding to real threats, and handing over cleanly between regions so that nothing is lost across shifts. The ideal candidate has solid SOC experience, a strong investigative mindset, and thrives in a fast-paced, fully remote setting where accuracy, discipline, and security are essential. Hands-on engineering experience with core security platforms is a big plus.
Responsibilities

• Monitor, triage, and analyze security alerts and events from the organization's security stack, including SIEM, Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), Security Service Edge (SSE), and Web Application Firewall (WAF) platforms.

• Investigate security incidents end to end, from initial triage through analysis, containment, eradication, and post-incident documentation, coordinating with relevant teams throughout.

• Determine the scope, severity, and impact of security events, separating true positives from false positives and escalating confirmed incidents according to defined procedures.

• Execute response actions within the security platforms, such as isolating endpoints, blocking indicators, disabling compromised accounts, and enforcing access restrictions.

• Ensure structured, high-quality shift handovers across regions in the follow-the-sun model, so that open investigations, ongoing incidents, and pending actions continue seamlessly around the clock.

• Proactively threat hunt across endpoint, network, and log data to uncover suspicious activity that existing detections may have missed, mapping findings to frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.

• Provide feedback on detection quality and contribute to the tuning of SIEM correlation rules, EDR custom detections, and WAF rules to reduce noise and improve coverage.

• Enrich investigations with threat intelligence, including indicators of compromise, attacker techniques, and emerging campaigns relevant to the organization.

• Develop and maintain technical documentation, standard operating procedures, and incident response playbooks.

• Collaborate with IT, infrastructure, application, and security engineering teams to resolve incidents and support day-to-day operations.

• Support vulnerability management and drive continuous improvement of the organization's overall security posture.

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

• At least 3 years of hands-on experience as a SOC Analyst, triaging alerts and investigating security incidents in a production environment.

• Solid working knowledge of core security technologies such as EDR, SSE, SIEM, and WAF, and of how to use them to investigate and respond to threats.

• Hands-on experience implementing, configuring, and tuning these platforms, or writing and tuning detection content, is a big plus.

• Experience with incident response and threat hunting, ideally with familiarity with the MITRE ATT&CK framework.

• Excellent understanding of network security, endpoint security, cloud security, and Zero Trust principles.

• Relevant certifications such as Security+, CySA+, GCIA, GCIH, BTL1, or vendor-specific credentials are a plus.

• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills with a high attention to detail.

• Ability to handle sensitive information responsibly and securely.

• Good written and verbal communication skills in English, and the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams and across time zones.

title: Redwood Automation Engineer (RunMyJobs / SAP BPA), SAP Finance, Luxembourg
description:
Redwood Automation Engineer (RunMyJobs / SAP BPA), SAP Finance, Luxembourg
Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Luxembourg. Day rate: EUR 350 a day. Language: English.
The programme
An established organisation is automating its finance close on Redwood, connected to SAP. Redwood Finance Automation runs on the same Redwood platform as RunMyJobs. SAP sold that platform for years as SAP Central Process Scheduling (CPS) and later SAP Business Process Automation (BPA). If you have built on it under any of those names, the experience carries straight across.
The work covers the record-to-report cycle: the period-end close, balance sheet reconciliation, accruals and journal posting, all running against SAP. You will build what the solution design sets out and carry each process through testing, go-live and early support.
What you will work on
The close built as Redwood process definitions: task lists, dependencies, parameters and calendars, including SAP factory calendars. Automated steps that run the SAP FI/CO period-end programs in the background, in the right order and with the right variants. Balance sheet reconciliation, accruals and journal posting automated on the platform. Logic in REL and RedwoodScript where the standard designer does not meet the requirement. The connection to SAP S/4HANA or ECC through XBP and RFC. Unit and integration testing, defect fixing, and support through user acceptance testing. Promotion between environments, cutover and hypercare. Technical documentation and handover to the support team.
What you bring
Hands-on build on the Redwood platform under any of its names: RunMyJobs, SAP BPA by Redwood, SAP CPS or Cronacle. You built the process definitions or job chains yourself. REL and RedwoodScript. SAP connections through XBP and RFC on at least one live SAP estate. Knowledge of the SAP FI/CO programs that run at month-end and the order they run in. 5 or more years in SAP automation, job scheduling or finance systems engineering.
Useful but not essential:
A migration from SAP BPA or SAP CPS to RunMyJobs. Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance). SAP Financial Closing cockpit or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. Financial services or another regulated industry, including work under SOX or similar audit controls.
How to respond
Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood, SAP CPS or SAP BPA work: what you automated, the SAP system it ran against, and what you built yourself.
About Yadimen
Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced Redwood and SAP automation people in front of the client.

title: User Acqusition Manager - ONYX
description:
[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/586ac3cb-f234-40cf-96fd-3daae8c41309/3a2721ac-0cf6-4bb5-a785-483b8d1018c3/Ashby_header.png]

Скільки разів за останній рік тобі дзвонили «зі служби безпеки банку»? Ти кладеш трубку за три секунди. А тепер уяви, що тобі 67, ти живеш в Огайо, і слово «фішинг» у тебе асоціюється тільки з риболовлею.

З AI шахраї опинилися на кілька кроків попереду звичайних людей. За хвилину AI клонує голос онука, пише лист «від банку» без жодної помилки і збирає сайт, який виглядає точно як справжній. Торік американці втратили на онлайн-шахрайстві понад $16 млрд.

Саме тому ми створюємо ONYX, персонального компаньйона у світі цифрової безпеки. Він допомагає кожному, хто не дуже впевнено почувається в інтернеті, вчасно помітити шахрайство і захиститися від нього. У продукті є моніторинг витоків персональних даних і їх видалення в дата-брокерів, браузерне розширення, яке блокує небезпечні сайти, перевірка безпеки телефона і короткі курси, після яких скам простіше впізнати.

Ми запустилися у 2026 році, вже маємо перші обсяги й результати і готуємося до масштабування. Ніша швидко росте, і в ній уже є як performance-, так і brand-driven гравці.

Про роль: ти станеш ключовою людиною в маркетингу ONYX і відповідатимеш за його головні напрями: залучення користувачів, нові підходи у воронках залучення і креативах, пошук нових каналів. Працюватимеш напряму з General Manager і разом з ним визначатимеш, куди рухається маркетинг продукту.

 

ЩО ТИ РОБИТИМЕШ

Залучення користувачів

- Відповідати за платне залучення, від запуску кампаній до результату.

- Закуповувати трафік у ключових каналах з цільовою маржею. Основний канал Meta, також Google, TikTok, AppLovin та інші.

- Масштабувати бюджети без втрати маржі.

- Шукати нові канали залучення та тестувати нестандартні підходи.

- Максимально автоматизувати процеси, щоб з часом мінімізувати свою ручну участь у закупці трафіку.

 

Воронки залучення, креативи і маркетингові сенси

- Шукати нові підходи у воронках залучення, креативах і комунікації з користувачами і впроваджувати їх на практиці.

- Бути драйвером нових ідей: приносити гіпотези, доводити їх до запуску і масштабувати те, що спрацювало.

- Стежити за маркетингом конкурентів: їхніми каналами, креативами, оферами.

- Відстежувати тренди ринку й рекламних платформ і ділитися інсайтами з командою.

 

* Класна можливість для тих, хто вже впевнено почувається в закупці: розширити свої горизонти й компетенції і по-справжньому розібратися в маркетингових сенсах, воронках і креативах.

 

ЩО ДЛЯ НАС ВАЖЛИВО

- 2+ роки досвіду в User Acquisition для B2C subscription-продуктів.

- Hands-on досвід закупки в Meta Ads на бюджетах від $100-200K на місяць.

- Досвід роботи з US і Tier-1 ринками.

- Розуміння, як маркетинг впливає на окупність, і що робити, коли показники просідають.

- Інтерес до маркетингових сенсів: воронок залучення, меседжів, креативів.

- Ти автоматизуєш рутину і щодня працюєш з AI-інструментами.

- Англійська B2+.

 

БУДЕ ПЛЮСОМ

- Досвід з веб-воронками і A/B-тестами.

- Досвід роботи з креативами: брифи, гіпотези, аналіз результатів.

- Бюджети від $500K на місяць.

- Досвід закупки в інших каналах, окрім Meta: Google, TikTok, AppLovin.

 

ЧОМУ ВАРТО ОБРАТИ ЦЮ РОЛЬ

- Стартап з результатами. ONYX уже показав перші сильні цифри і готується до скейлу. Ти приходиш у момент, коли кожне твоє рішення видно в P&L.

- Ядро бізнесу. Команда, яка формується зараз, стане core майбутньої компанії.

- Ріст за межі закупки. Тут можна прокачати фундаментальний маркетинг: воронки, сенси, креативи. Це прямий шлях до full-cycle маркетолога.

- Вільні лідерські ролі. Lead UA / Growth, лід будь-якої маркетингової вертикалі або Head of Marketing. Залежить від того, де ти найкраще проявиш себе.

- Свобода в інструментах. Можна робити ставку на закупку, а можна нарощувати бюджети через креативи й воронки. Обираєш сам, під свій скілсет.

 

ЯК МИ ПРАЦЮЄМО

Ми AI-native команда. 100% коду генерує AI, вся робот

Estamos ampliando nuestra red de Touchers (researchers- recruiters freelance).
¿Qué buscamos?
Expertos en diferentes industrias y sectores, que quieran ser partícipes de un nuevo modelo de scouting y reclutamiento.
En nuestro modelo hemos decidido darle al cliente la opción de elegir. Y de combinar.
El cliente decide cuántos candidatos quiere ver y en qué plazo de tiempo. Sin preocuparse de más.
Por este motivo TinT surge como un concepto revolucionario, una forma de hacer reclutamiento y resolver procesos de selección de manera práctica, sencilla y cómoda.
Y que da resultados. Buenísimos resultados.
¿Por qué? porque no lo hacemos con máquinas.
Porque el motor son personas. Gente muy buena en lo suyo, gente como tú.
El corazón de todo esto son nuestros Touchers (recruiters en la vida normal), que colaboran en modalidad freelance y forman nuestro equipo.
Sin embargo, la libertad es para nosotros un principio básico y por ello eres libre de:

• Elegir cuánto tiempo nos quieres dedicar.

• Elegir cuánto quieres ganar en base al volumen de proyectos que quieres/puedes abordar.

• Elegir desde donde quieres trabajar.

Sólo nos importa lo bien que lo hagas y que nuestros clientes estén felices con el resultado.
En definitiva, se trata de construir juntos un nuevo concepto y una forma revolucionaria de hacer scouting y reclutamiento, de ser el dueño de tu tiempo, y de construir una colaboración permanente o discontinua, según te vaya yendo la vida o cuanto quieras ganar.
Te ofrecemos, una fórmula de trabajo clara, sencilla y transparente. Aportamos los medios de reclutamiento y clientes, y lo más importante, la seguridad de que cobras, conociendo de antemano el retorno que obtendrás de tu trabajo. Sin sorpresas, ¡no trabajamos a éxito!
Los timings con los que trabajamos son retadores pero realistas y te permitirán dimensionar tu carga de trabajo y no involucrarte en proyectos eternos que disminuyen la rentabilidad de tu trabajo.
¿Una fórmula de este tipo podría encajarte? ¿Es lo que estás buscando?
Cuéntanos qué sabes hacer y qué mercados / perfiles / idiomas conoces o cuánto tiempo querrías dedicarnos!
Tan sólo necesitamos que seas un experto en research y búsqueda, que no seas conformista y que te apasionen los retos. ¡De ponerlos a tu alcance nos encargamos nosotros!
Tipo de empleo
Jornada completa
Experiencia de al menos 3 años en reclutamiento y selección.
Interés por colaborar en formato freelance.
Deseable nivel alto de inglés
Hola! Somos Touch in Touch .
¿Otra consultora? Sí. ¿Haciendo lo mismo? Para nada.
Hacemos RECLUTAMIENTO. Scouting de candidatos.
Mira. Tenemos claro que no funciona esperar un mes para ver candidatos cuando el cliente los necesita ya. Y que no funciona pagar un dineral por un proceso y encima duplicar fases. Y pagarlas, claro.
O eso de que un externo le diga al cliente si el candidato encaja en su organización.
En Touch in Touch somos más rápidos, somos más certeros y nuestros precios son para todos.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Overview
At Cotiviti , we are custodians of data for our clients. Using their technical experience in ETL processes, Data Engineers ensure operational functions are occurring as expected. This includes but is not limited to managing data implementations, data production, data quality, and data security.
Responsibilities

• Create, maintain and execute basic to intermediate SQL scripts for data management and data validation.

• Optimize the queries to improve the efficiency of daily tasks.

• Perform data analysis and identify any issues.

• Work with other groups such as Engineering team, DBA etc. to troubleshoot and resolve any environmental or network issues that impact your work. Extend your support to after-hours or weekends as needed.

• Create and maintain dashboards as needed.

• Validates the tasks results to ensure that all the requirements are met.

• Adhere to all the industry level and organization level compliance rules and regulations to maintain data integrity.

• Complete individual productivity tracking.

• Complete task assignments using department ticketing system within assigned deadline.

• Achieve organizational and individual goals as identified in performance reviews and goal setting exercises.

• Complete all responsibilities as outlined in the annual performance review and/or goal setting.

• Complete all special projects and other duties as assigned.

• Must be able to perform duties with or without reasonable accommodation.

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed and is not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties and skills required. This job description does not constitute an employment agreement and is subject to change as the needs of Cotiviti and requirements of the job change.
Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or equivalent work experience.

• 2+ years of working knowledge of RDBMS (Oracle, MS SQL, Vertica, etc.) and experience using SQL, PL/SQL or other data integration/ETL tools.

• 2+ years of data analysis. Preferably in the Healthcare industry of enrollment, medical claims and/or pharmacy claims.

• Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite applications PowerPoint, Word, Excel and Outlook.

• Flexible work schedule.

• Experience with project management tools like JIRA.

• Strong analytical skills.

• Excellent verbal, listening and written communication skills.

• Ability to multitask and prioritize projects to meet scheduled deadlines and tight turnaround times.

• Ability to work well independently or in a team environment.

Mental Requirements:

•
Critical Thinking: Analyze problems objectively and make sound, data-driven decisions.

•
Attention to Detail: Maintain accuracy across code, data, and deliverables.

•
Quantitative Skills: Apply strong analytical and statistical methods to solve problems.

•
Data Interpretation: Extract actionable insights from data, metrics, and visualizations.

•
Communication: Clearly explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

•
Learning Agility: Quickly adopt new tools, technologies, and best practices.

•
Resilience: Adapt to shifting priorities and deliver under pressure.

•
Integrity: Handle data responsibly and uphold engineering and ethical standards.

Physical Requirements and Working Conditions:

• Remaining in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods.

• Repeating motions that may include the wrists, hands, and/or fingers.

• Must be able to provide a dedicated, secure work area.

• Must be able to provide high-speed internet access / connectivity and office setup and maintenance.

title: Tech Lead - Engineering Manager - AI Detection and Response
description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Tech Lead - Engineering Manager - AI Detection and Response to join our team. This is a Hybrid (Zagreb or Split office based, any) role, reporting to Luka Simac in the Red Teaming department. As a Tech Lead / Engineering Manager - AI Detection and Response, you will build and lead the team behind the product, own its architecture, and take it from product requirements to a production service that security operations teams rely on. The role combines technical leadership with people leadership to redefine the future of AI Security solutions.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

•
Build and lead the engineering team, hiring talent, running 1:1s, setting goals, and supporting individual career growth

•
Work with product management to cut a broad product vision into shippable milestones, writing detailed specs, cost structures, and data scale requirements

•
Own the product architecture, including cloud AI connectors, telemetry ingestion, asset graphs, and detection and response services

•
Build multi-tenant pipelines that ingest platform APIs, audit logs, and OpenTelemetry traces efficiently to show clear detection coverage boundaries

•
Stay hands-on by prototyping with AI coding tools, writing code for the most challenging problems, and reviewing designs

Who You Are (Success Profile)

•
You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.

•
You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. true ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.

•
You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.

•
You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback-knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.

•
You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and never stop developing yourself, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

•
Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain

•
Strong backend engineering experience in C# and .NET (ASP.NET Core) or Python, including designing REST and gRPC APIs

•
Cloud: Hands-on experience with AWS, including IAM, CloudT

About Us

Fanatics is a leading global sports platform redefining how fans connect with the teams, players and moments they love. Our businesses - Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, Fanatics Betting & Gaming, Fanatics Events, Fanatics Advertising, Fanatics Markets and Fanatics Studios - maximize the presence and reach for hundreds of partners globally and create a one-stop experience that allows fans to buy, bet, collect, and earn, while engaging with sports in deeper, more immersive ways. This includes licensed fan gear and lifestyle products, sportsbook and iGaming, physical and digital trading cards, live events, premium sports entertainment content, credit card offerings and more. Together, they form a powerful, integrated ecosystem - connected by the Fanatics ONE loyalty program and FanCash, the currency of sport - delivering personalized experiences to over 100 million fans worldwide. Fanatics holds partnerships with over 900 sports properties, from professional leagues and players’ associations to teams, colleges and retail partners; over 7,000 athletes and celebrities; and over 2,000 retail locations, including all Lids stores. Backed by a team of more than 22,000 employees, Fanatics is committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience.

 

About the Company

Fanatics Collect is a global product and technology group dedicated to revolutionizing the world of collectibles. Every single day our team of experienced product leaders, engineers, and operators obsesses over how to create the ultimate collector experience with our products: Topps.com, the direct to consumer ecommerce platform of the Topps brand, Fanatics Collect, the most trusted and dynamic collector focused marketplace, and our collector focused live shopping platforms, Fanatics Live and Voggt.

If you're passionate about building world class products and share our love for sports fans and collectors, Fanatics Collect offers an exciting opportunity to be part of a dynamic team creating the future of collecting.

• Supporting onboarding and training for new Senior Agents in partnership with the Training and Quality function

• Fostering a culture of accountability, responsiveness, and continuous improvement across the Senior Agent team

title: Account Executive
description:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets - the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Build new client relationships in a defined territory, combining thoughtful account prioritization with the pace and persistence to create opportunities at scale. With a large pool of untapped accounts still to break into, you’ll build your own book of business rather than inherit a fixed set of relationships.

This role is for a hunter who sells with focus. You’ll prioritise accounts, prospect and create opportunities across multiple buying groups, run well-managed pilots, and close a steady flow of deals, with clear ownership of the relationship from first outreach through the early customer relationship. Your results are visible, you’ll help shape a newly tiered sales organisation, and you’ll grow within a clearer individual contributor progression path.

Every day is different, but here’s an example of the kind of things you’ll work on:

- Own a defined territory, prioritise accounts, and win new clients.

- Prospect and create opportunities across the buying groups within each target account, and build a reliable, repeatable pipeline.

- Qualify quickly and run well-managed pilot processes from start to close.

- Communicate 9fin’s value proposition to clients through tailored demos.

- Negotiate and close new business, including multi-year agreements where it makes sense.

- Build account plans that map the organisation and identify teams and desks to expand into.

- Keep clear CRM records and forecast accurately.

- Partner with Customer Success, Enablement, and Rev Ops so deals move cleanly from pilot to onboarding.

- Share ideas with senior management to shape Commercial team processes and best practices.

- Bring client feedback to Product so the platform keeps improving for our users.

- Have 2+ years of relevant Account Executive experience ideally in capital markets and/or Fintech SaaS.

- Have a hunter mindset and a track record of generating your own pipeline and exceeding targets, ideally in a high-volume sales environment.

- Have a good knowledge of financial markets and the ability to build strong relationships within the 9fin community.

- Can plan and prioritise across many opportunities at once, with accuracy and attention to detail.

- Communicate clearly in writing and in conversation.

- Build trust across a matrixed commercial organization and partner effectively with Customer Success, Content and Product.

- Have an existing network in the leveraged finance community (helpful but not required).

- Thrive in ambitious, fast-moving environments where expectations are high, opportunities are abundant, and no two days look the same.

We’re a scaling start up, and we enjoy sharing our success, when the company succeeds, we always reinvest that in our people. We also offer huge amounts of responsibility, an abundance of opportunity for growth and a platform to truly excel.

title: Sr Software Engineer I, Forward Deployed Engineering
description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact

Dedrone by Axon protects airspace from drone threats. Each deployment combines our software, our own and partner sensors, and a networking stack that connects the site to DedroneC2 in the cloud. As a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer, you are part of the team that owns the technical outcome at our most critical customer sites. This is a software and systems role. You work mostly through remote access to customer sites, and our installation teams and partners do the physical work.

You take each problem from live triage to a fix in the field, then make sure the long-term fix lands in the product. You have the authority to raise defects and to join design reviews with our product teams, based on what you see first-hand. One question guides the work: how do we leave the product better than we found it, so nobody has to work this issue again?

What You’ll Do

Location: Hybrid. Up to 20% travel required, to customer sites, demonstrations, and exercises.

Must be within commutable distance to one of our Hub locations listed below: Sterling VA)

Reports to: Engineering Manager, Forward Deployed Engineering

• Own complex site issues end to end: lead the incident, get the site working, and write the review afterwards.

• Resolve live site problems that Support escalates, diagnosing failures across software, sensors, and networks with customers and installers.

• Write the fixes, integrations, and automation that get a site working, and set the quality bar for field fixes through code reviews.

• Leave no one-off behind: move each site-specific fix into the product or retire it, and follow the root cause with our product teams until the fix ships.

• Set the standards for the runbooks, checklists, acceptance tests, and monitoring that make deployments repeatable.

• Mentor engineers on the team, and coach Support and installers on what you learn.

• Take part in the engineering on-call rota.

• Use AI-assisted engineering tools across your work, and help the team use them well.

What You Bring

• 6+ years of experience in software engineering, site reliability, or systems integration

• Production ownership: you have been on call, led incidents, and debugged live systems from logs and metrics

• Proficiency in at least one programming language, such as Python or Java, with a record of shipping code to production

• Clear communication with customers, installers, and engineers during live incidents

• Experience mentoring engineers and conducting technical interviews

• Hands-on experience with AI-assisted engineering tools and workflows

• Deep experience in one of these:

• Software: you have designed and owned production services, and you can find and fix a defect in a large codebase that you did not write.

• Systems: you have deployed and troubleshot Linux systems and IP networks at production or customer sites, including integration with third-party equipment.

Work Location

title: Operations Specialist III, Lifesciences (US)
description:
Company Introduction:

Airspace is a tech-enabled freight forwarder that’s redefining how the world’s most critical packages are delivered. Headquartered in Carlsbad, California, Airspace has employees who are based around the world. Our European headquarters is in Amsterdam, The Netherlands.

As a recognized leader in AI and machine learning, our team leverages data and patented technology to coordinate logistics across a global network of drivers and airlines. Our goal is to deliver those packages that are truly mission-critical in a way that is faster, more transparent, more secure, and more accountable than ever before. The items we deliver range from organs for transplant, to parts for critical machinery including grounded aircraft and highly sensitive components such as semiconductors.

Airspace has been rated one of America’s best Startup Employers and listed as one of CNBC’s Disruptor 50 companies. Airspace has the support of leading investors such as Telstra Ventures, HarbourVest Partners, Defy Partners, DBL Partners, and Scale Ventures. To date the company has raised more than $140m.

The company is growing rapidly and serving more places around the world than ever before. We are looking for passionate, motivated individuals who want to make an IMPACT every day to help us execute on our mission of reshaping the world of time-critical logistics.

Be the Team's Deepest Problem-Solver
Every ops floor needs a small number of people who can be handed the hardest problem in the queue and trusted to get it right - balancing cost, speed, and customer impact without defaulting to escalation. As an Operations Specialist III, you're that person for your team.
You resolve what OS I and OS II can't, you help the team solve it themselves next time, and you understand the business well enough to make the close calls - which carrier, which cost, which tradeoff - that protect both service quality and margin. For the rare issue that needs to be fielded by someone supporting Ops leadership and account managers directly, you know when to bring in an Ops Expert.
What You'll Do
Must be able to perform all responsibilities included in the Operations Specialist II job description, in addition to the following:
Resolve the Hardest Escalations

• Independently resolve all escalated issues using available resources with minimal to no assistance

• Assist in resolving team member escalations and questions

• Anticipate problems before they surface and act early

Make the Margin and Cost Tradeoffs

• Understand margin versus total cost for an order and apply that knowledge to additional charge approvals

• Balance speed, cost, and customer impact when making big-picture decisions, without defaulting to escalation (e.g., choosing a carrier based on service reliability and error-rate history rather than the fastest or cheapest option alone)

• Maintain deep, practiced knowledge of the trade, regulatory, and compliance requirements relevant to your assigned sector

Set the Standard for the Team

• Serve as the go-to resource on sector-specific process nuance and edge cases within the team

• Flag SOP gaps and suggest improvements to your supervisor based on frontline experience

• Uphold team expectations by leading through example

• Maintain any certifications required for your assigned sector and stay current on related compliance requirements; assist teammates with related questions

Maintain a Balanced Level of Performance
As an OS III, you'll be expected to maintain minimal to no errors or service failures, make sound decisions under pressure, and meet the customer service standards appropriate for this level. Specific metrics vary by sector and will be communicated by your direct reporting supervisor.
Requirements

• Demonstrated success as an Operations Specialist II, or equivalent experience independently resolving complex, time-critical logistics escalations

• Working knowledge of margin and cost tradeoffs, and comfort applying that know

About the Client: Our client is a U.S.-based personal injury law firm serving individuals and families in Chicago. With decades of legal experience, the firm helps clients pursue compensation for injuries caused by negligence, emphasizing personalized service, compassionate support, and strong client advocacy.
Overview: The Pre-Litigation Paralegal is responsible for managing a high-volume caseload from intake through settlement. This role ensures cases progress efficiently, and client communication remains consistent, organized, and professional. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, proactive, and capable of managing deadlines, records requests, negotiations support, and file preparation with minimal supervision.
Responsibilities :

• Client Communication & Case Management

• Serve as the primary point of contact for clients during the pre-litigation stage.

• Conduct regular follow-up calls to ensure treatment, compliance, and case progress.

• Document all communication and updates within the case management system.

• Manage a case load of 110-120.

• Request and track medical records, bills, imaging, lien documents, and police reports.

• Create and update medical summaries, billing ledgers, and treatment timelines.

• Communicate with medical providers regarding liens, and balances.

• Maintain accurate digital file organization, ensuring all case data, notes, and documentation are current.

• Prepare settlement demand packages including narrative summaries, injury details, liability analysis, and supporting documents

• Demand & Negotiation Support

• Draft high-quality demand letters based on attorney guidance.

• Prepare negotiation summaries and assist attorneys during settlement discussions.

• Monitor statute deadlines and escalate when necessary.

• Documentation & Administrative Tasks

• Track insurance adjuster communications and ensure timely follow-up.

• Upload and organize signature documents related to each case.

Qualifications:

• Bilingual English/Spanish strongly preferred - bilingual candidates will receive priority consideration.

• Minimum 2-5+ years of plaintiff-side personal injury experience, with pre-litigation case management experience preferred.

• Strong understanding of auto accidents, premises liability, med-pay/PIP, medical liens, and insurance workflows.

• Proficiency with legal case management systems, Microsoft Office, and document drafting; Filevine experience preferred.

• Excellent written, verbal, organizational, and deadline-management skills.

title: Marketing Operations / Campaign Coordinator
description:
About Outpace Professional Services
OPS delivers enterprise-grade ERP, automation, and sovereign technology solutions for ambitious businesses that need to move fast without sacrificing quality. From startups to large-scale global operations, we provide the expertise clients need, when they need it, without the overhead of traditional consulting firms.
Our team specialises in Odoo ERP, hyper-automation, systems integration, and operational transformation, helping organisations build scalable, efficient, and fully controlled technology ecosystems.
At OPS, we value agility, transparency, and excellence without ego. We move quickly, solve real problems and focus on delivering measurable impact for every client we work with.
About the Role
Outpace is hiring a Marketing Operations / Campaign Coordinator to keep marketing execution organized, timely, and clean.
This role is the execution and hygiene layer for marketing. You will keep campaigns moving, assets organized, systems clean, deadlines visible, and reporting usable across Growth, RevOps, SDR, Sales, and external partners.
This is a great fit for someone who enjoys managing details, building repeatable processes, and turning marketing plans into well-run campaign launches.
What You’ll Do

• Own the marketing campaign calendar and keep launches, deadlines, assets, approvals, and dependencies visible.

• Coordinate campaign execution across email, webinars, landing pages, events, paid campaigns, partner campaigns, and content launches.

• Build and maintain campaign checklists, briefs, launch trackers, asset folders, and reporting templates.

• Coordinate landing pages, forms, UTMs, tracking links, audience lists, and campaign QA before launch.

• Partner with RevOps to ensure clean lead source tracking, campaign attribution, routing, and SDR handoff.

• Support webinar and event logistics, including registration, reminders, speaker coordination, follow-up lists, and post-event reporting.

• Manage marketing vendors, freelancers, designers, and agencies when needed.

• Maintain the marketing asset library and make sure sales teams can find the latest approved collateral.

• Prepare weekly campaign performance snapshots for the Growth Lead and RevOps.

What We’re Looking For

• Experience coordinating B2B marketing campaigns, marketing operations, or revenue marketing projects.

• Strong project management habits and excellent attention to detail.

• Comfort working with CRM systems, marketing automation tools, spreadsheets, Notion or other project management tools, and reporting workflows.

• Ability to operate calmly across many moving pieces without losing details.

• Clear communication and strong follow-through with cross-functional teams.

Nice to Have

• Experience with HubSpot, Salesforce, Odoo, Apollo, LinkedIn campaigns, webinar platforms, or similar go-to-market systems.

• Experience supporting a fast-growing SDR or AE organization.

• Comfort using AI tools to accelerate briefs, QA, list checks, reporting, and campaign production.

What Success Looks Like

• Campaigns launch on time and with complete QA.

• Attribution, UTM, source, and routing hygiene are clean and reliable.

• Campaign errors, missed handoffs, and outdated collateral are reduced.

• Marketing, SDR, RevOps, and Sales have better visibility into campaign status and performance.

• Weekly campaign reporting is consistent, useful, and trusted.

First 90 Days
In your first 90 days, you will:

• Create one source of truth for the marketing calendar.

• Build campaign templates, launch checklists, and reporting formats.

• Audit the current campaign tracking and handoff process with RevOps.

• Organize the first version of the marketing asset library.

• Support the launch of the first priority campaigns from the Growth Lead.

Conduct legal and policy research, analyses, and summaries  

Common Cause is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants of any race, creed, color, religion, ethnicity, national origin, income class, political affiliation, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, veteran status, or marital status, as well as applicants who have been previously incarcerated. 
 
Common Cause (501(c)(4)) and Common Cause Education Fund (501(c)(3)) are nonpartisan, nonprofit grassroots affiliate organizations dedicated to upholding the core values of American democracy.
