About Us

Fanatics is a leading global sports platform redefining how fans connect with the teams, players and moments they love. Our businesses - Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, Fanatics Betting & Gaming, Fanatics Events, Fanatics Advertising, Fanatics Markets and Fanatics Studios - maximize the presence and reach for hundreds of partners globally and create a one-stop experience that allows fans to buy, bet, collect, and earn, while engaging with sports in deeper, more immersive ways. This includes licensed fan gear and lifestyle products, sportsbook and iGaming, physical and digital trading cards, live events, premium sports entertainment content, credit card offerings and more. Together, they form a powerful, integrated ecosystem - connected by the Fanatics ONE loyalty program and FanCash, the currency of sport - delivering personalized experiences to over 100 million fans worldwide. Fanatics holds partnerships with over 900 sports properties, from professional leagues and players’ associations to teams, colleges and retail partners; over 7,000 athletes and celebrities; and over 2,000 retail locations, including all Lids stores. Backed by a team of more than 22,000 employees, Fanatics is committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience.

 

About the Company

Fanatics Collectibles is a new company operating at the intersection of collectibles, culture, and technology. Backed by world-class investors, operators, and sports & entertainment partners, we are building the global leader in next-generation collectibles. As part of the broader Fanatics ecosystem, we leverage a digital sports platform that spans over 900 sports properties and engages more than 81 million fans. Together, we are reimagining every part of the collectibles experience for fans, partners, and creators.

Position Summary

The Senior Director, AI Deployment is a hands-on delivery leader accountable for putting AI into production and generating measurable business results. This leader will build and run the AI Deployment Team: 3 to 5 forward-deployed AI practitioners who embed with business units, uncover real workflow problems, build and deploy solutions, and leave each team more capable and self-sufficient. Think forward-deployed engineers, built internally.

The core job is to re-engineer how work gets done and deploy AI and autonomous agents into production workflows. Success is measured by workflows redesigned, agents and applications running in production, and business impact validated with Finance and business owners, not by roadmaps, training hours, or pilots.

The Senior Director sets deployment priorities enterprise-wide, partners with IT, engineering, data, cybersecurity, legal, and enterprise architecture to deploy safely and at pace, and advises executives on where AI will and won't create value. Governance, platforms, and adoption programs matter, and this leader makes them serve deployment rather than replace it.

Key Responsibilities

1. Build and Lead the AI Deployment Team

•
Recruit and lead 3 to 5 forward-deployed AI practitioners: builders with real engineering depth, business fluency, and credibility with operators and executives.

•
Set the standard for craft: technical practices, code and design review, evaluation discipline, and delivery cadence.

•
Define the engagement model: how business units are selected, how embeds are scoped and run, what success looks like, and how work is handed off.

•
Stay hands-on: scope problems, shape architecture, review work, and build alongside the team when it matters.

•
Allocate the team to the highest-value opportunities, make explicit tradeoffs, and decline work that won't move a business outcome.

•
Develop team members into the next generation of technical and business leaders.

2. Embed, Re-engineer Workflows, and Deploy to Production

•
Embed with business units to see how work is actually done and identify where AI can change cost, speed, quality, or revenue.

Senior Software Engineer (.NET)
The company and our mission: 
Zartis is a global AI transformation and technology consulting partner where talented engineers and technologists work on cutting edge innovation. We partner with ambitious organizations to design, build, and scale technology solutions that deliver real impact.
Our teams bring deep expertise in AI driven platforms, secure API architectures, and cloud native engineering. You will work on meaningful projects that accelerate the adoption of advanced technologies, from strategy and discovery through to full product delivery, helping turn complex challenges into measurable outcomes.
With engineering hubs across EMEA and LATAM, and long term partnerships in financial services, healthcare and life sciences, and energy and climate, we offer opportunities to work on projects that truly matter. Here, you will not just build technology, you will drive business impact and grow your career alongside industry leaders.
We are looking for a  Senior Software Engineer to work on a project in the financial services / banking sector.
The project:

Our teammates are talented people that come from a variety of backgrounds. We’re committed to building an inclusive culture based on trust and innovation.
You will be part of a distributed team working for a UK FCA/PRA-authorised bank and its recently acquired motor finance business. The software the motor finance business runs on is built on .NET versions that are no longer supported. You will upgrade these applications to a supported version and fix any problems in the shared code they depend on.
The project is planned as AI-assisted, so engineers will use AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot or Claude as part of their everyday work.
We are looking for someone with good communication skills, ideally with experience making decisions, being proactive, and with good attention to detail.
What you will do:
Upgrade unsupported .NET applications, mostly older .NET Framework apps, to a supported version, working through the issues that come up along the way.
Fix problems in the shared code that these applications depend on.
Work within the existing environment, including IIS and Windows Server, SQL Server and AWS.
Use GitHub for source control, and build, test and deploy your changes through GitHub Actions.
Use AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot or Claude as part of your day-to-day development, in line with the AI-assisted approach of the project.
Work closely with the rest of the distributed team to keep the upgrades moving.

What you will bring:
6+ years of commercial .NET experience.
Hands-on experience upgrading .NET Framework applications to a supported version.
Experience with IIS on Windows Server, including running .NET applications on it.
Solid experience with SQL Server.
Already working with AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot or Claude, as the project is AI-assisted.
Good communication skills and attention to detail, with the ability to be proactive and make decisions.
Nice to have:
Experience with AWS.
Financial services experience.
Regular use of AI-assisted development.
What we offer:

100% Remote Work
WFH allowance: Monthly payment as financial support for remote working.
Career Growth: We have established a career development program accessible for all employees with a 360º feedback that will help us to guide you in your career progression.
Training: For Tech training at Zartis, you have time allocated during the week at your disposal. You can request from a variety of options, such as online courses (from Pluralsight and Educative.io, for example), English classes, books, conferences, and events.
Mentoring Program: You can become a mentor in Zartis or you can receive mentorship, or both.
Zartis Wellbeing Hub (Kara Connect): A platform that provides sessions with a range of specialists, including mental health professionals, nutritionists, physiotherapists, fitness coaches, and webinars with such professionals as well.

description:
WHO WE ARE

Aurelius is the autonomous directed energy company.

We are a group of engineers, operators, and company patriots building American-made, laser-based counter-UAS systems that neutralize aerial threats.

Archimedes, our autonomous laser turret, combines a high-power laser with radar and machine vision to find, track, and defeat small drones. We design in San Francisco, manufacture in Detroit, and test onsite, on our own cUAS range.

ABOUT THE TEAM

You'll work directly with our CEO while also providing support to our CTO and the rest of the company. You’ll have your hands in calendar management, inbox organization, meetings, travel coordination, follow-ups, special projects, and taking on whatever needs to get done each day.

This is not a role with fixed boundaries or a detailed playbook. It’s fast-paced, demands high throughput, and holds a high bar for detail. We’re a hardware company, so there are days when you’ll help move equipment, set up in the shop, or assist with a test or event.

We value what you’ve built, shipped, and managed far more than your years of experience or previous titles.

MUST-HAVES

- Willing to work weekends when needed, including Saturdays for test days, events, or travel

- Owned mission-critical work where errors are public and consistently kept error rates at zero-think models, trackers, client deliverables, production releases

- Hands-on experience in a fast-moving, venture-backed startup, competitive athletics, military, or other chaotic environment, and actually shipped real results

- Physically able to regularly lift 50 lbs

- U.S. citizenship (required for export control)

WHAT YOU’LL OWN

- The founder’s calendar from end to end: every meeting confirmed, every time zone accurate, every conflict detected before it becomes an issue

- Inbox triage and follow-ups: capture action items from every meeting and close them out that day

- Planning and logistics for field tests, demos, and travel-covering flights, hotels, ground transportation, gear, and backup plans for shifting schedules

- Special projects, start to finish: get handed a messy problem by the CEO and return with a tangible solution, not a status update

- Error-free operations tracking: vendors, purchasing, SaaS subscriptions, renewals, and managing the spreadsheets the company runs on

- Building internal tools and automations: if it needs to be done more than once, design a spreadsheet, script, or AI workflow so no one does it manually a third time

- Coordinating visitors and site visits, including NDAs and scheduling

- Physical work: moving hardware, organizing equipment, and lending a hand at the shop, test sites, and events. When something needs carrying, you’re already on it

NICE TO HAVES

- Started a business that earned real revenue

- Familiarity with SQL or scripting languages

- Built a tool or automation that’s been used by others

- Experience in hardware, manufacturing, or defense industries

- Experience coordinating logistics for events, trips, or field operations

NOT A FIT IF

- You’re looking for a classic EA or admin role with clear boundaries

- You can’t or don’t want to work weekends when the role requires it

- You prefer a slow, predictable work pace

- You’re unfazed by typos and incomplete work

- You’re unwilling to lift, haul, or get your hands dirty

- You only want strategy work, not execution

- You can’t be onsite five days a week

HOW YOU OPERATE

- You take action immediately and prefer solving problems now over scheduling a meeting

- You address challenges before they land in anyone’s inbox

- Comfortable working with ambiguity and rapid iteration in a startup environment

- Communicate clearly with the team, leadership, and vendors

- You’re proactive and take initiative-no one needs to tell you what needs to happen next.

HOW WE WORK

At Aurelius we work what we call, 5+X. Our core operating hours are 5 days a week, Monday to Friday, 9am to 6pm Pacific Time.

About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations:  SF Bay Area

At Cloudflare, our mission is bold yet simple: to help build a better Internet. We are builders, storytellers, and connectors united by one goal: to make Cloudflare the best place for developers to build.

The Developer GTM organization partners tightly with Sales, Product, Finance, Legal, RevOps, and Marketing.
